g.text: The small trail beside intentions pulses during capture and
freezes on pause. Click it or press B for visits, timestamps,
durations, app colors, and logos. The bottom status line
In scope matches your plan. Deviation is outside it; it need not
mean wasted time. Unknown means verification was unavailable.
Activity off · B focus branches / scope
SPACE start/pause · B branches · E intentions · H history · C config · CTRL+N
LEFT / RIGHT steps · TAB buttons · ESC close · scroll for more
